## What We Covered

| Backend | Paradigm |
|---|---|
| Qiskit Aer | Local gate-based simulation |
| BlueQubit | Cloud gate-based simulation |
| IQM Resonance | Gate-based QPU |
| IBM Quantum | Gate-based QPU |
| D-Wave Leap | Quantum annealing |
| Quantinuum Guppy | MCMR |

---

## Choosing the Right Backend

| Goal | Backend | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Simulation | Qiskit Aer | Free, local, no queue |
| Simulation | BlueQubit | Scale-up |
| Optimization | D-Wave | Ad hoc system |
| European QPU | IQM | Sovereignty |
| Largest QPUs | IBM | 150+ qubit systems |
| Extend gate | Quantinuum | Native MCMR support |

. . .

There is no single best platform

---

## The Quantum Stack

```
Your algorithm
      │
  SDK / IR  <-- Qiskit, Ocean, Guppy
      │
Transpiler  <-- gate decomposition, minor embedding
      │
 Hardware   <-- Gate QPU, Annealer, Simulator
```

. . .

The abstraction layers are the same as classical computing,
what changes is the physics underneath
